findings.evidence: Grep/read hits show unannotated theorem declarations at `SchwarzPickIsometry.lean:64`, `:81`, and `:91`, each rewriting `pseudoHyperbolicExpr (automorphism z) (automorphism w)` to `pseudoHyperbolicExpr z w`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these three theorems so `simp` can reduce the pseudo-hyperbolic expression after applying the Moebius/standard automorphism back to the original expression.
findings.issue: The public invariance lemmas `pseudoHyperbolicExpr_unitDiscMoebiusFormula_of_norm_lt_one`, `pseudoHyperbolicExpr_unitDiscMoebius`, and `pseudoHyperbolicExpr_unitDiscStandardAutomorphismEquiv` are characteristic normal-form reductions but are not tagged `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: `PseudoHyperbolic.lean:86` declares `lemma pseudoHyperbolicExpr_const_mul {c : ℂ} (hc : ‖c‖ = 1) ... : pseudoHyperbolicExpr (c * z) (c * w) = pseudoHyperbolicExpr z w` with no automation attribute.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `pseudoHyperbolicExpr_const_mul`; the rewrite strictly removes the common unit scalar when the local unit-norm hypothesis is available.
findings.issue: `pseudoHyperbolicExpr_const_mul` is the corresponding rotation normal form, but it is also exported without `@[simp]`.

summary: The exported isometry API is missing the simp annotations that make these characteristic invariance lemmas usable as normal forms.
